scripts.text:
Wait a minute!
-You need to have an-
-^4d4dff'Eden Group Mark'^000000-
-to receive these missions.-
scripts.translation:
等一下！
-您需要持有-
-^4d4dff'樂園團徽章'^000000-
-才能領取這些任務。-

scripts.text: How can I be a member of the ^0000FFEden Group^000000?
scripts.translation: 如何成為^0000FF樂園團^000000的成員？

scripts.text:
::The Eden Group Missions
::are basically missions
::requested by
::people from all around the kingdom.
::We just categorize them.
scripts.translation:
::樂園團的任務
::基本上是來自王國各地
::人們的委託。
::我們只是將它們分類而已。

scripts.text:
::In the Eden Group,
::we sorted out the missions
::according to the level of difficulty.
::According to this level,
::you can find
::missions that
::suit you.
scripts.translation:
::在樂園團中，
::我們根據難度對任務進行了分類。
::根據這個等級，
::您可以找到
::適合您的
::任務。

scripts.text:
::When you are done,
::you can come back
::to the mission board.

::Then you will be
::rewarded!!
::Simple, isn't it!!
::No commission required!!
scripts.translation:
::然後您將獲得
::獎勵！！
::很簡單，不是嗎！！
::無需手續費！！

scripts.text:
::You can become a member
::of the Eden Group
::to ^0000FFLaime Evenor^000000,
::who is waiting on the 1st floor.
scripts.translation:
::您可以向^0000FF萊梅·艾文諾^000000
::申請成為樂園團的成員，
::他正在一樓等候。

scripts.text:
::If you become a member,
::you will get an
::"^006400Eden Group Mark^000000".
::Then you will be able
::to see the mission board.
scripts.translation:
::成為成員後，
::您將獲得
::"^006400樂園團徽章^000000"。
::之後您就能
::看到任務板了。

scripts.text: You must be within level 86-90 to accept these missions.
scripts.translation: 您的等級必須在86-90級之間才能接受這些任務。

scripts.text:
:: You cannot proceed in
:: ^0000FF{0} Hunting^000000.
:: The registration to the mission
:: is cancelled.

:: You added information
:: about the mission
:: ^0000FF{0} Hunting^000000
:: on the mission board.
:: You've got a
:: salutary experience.
scripts.translation:
:: 您已在任務板上
:: 添加了關於
:: ^0000FF{0}狩獵^000000
:: 任務的資訊。
:: 您獲得了一次
:: 有益的經驗。

scripts.text:
[86-90 Mission Board]
There are several requests on this board.
scripts.translation:
[86-90級任務板]
這塊板上有幾個委託。

scripts.text:
^8B4513Turtle Island^000000.
Which monster will you hunt or have you finished hunting?
scripts.translation:
^8B4513海龜島^000000。
您要狩獵哪種魔物，或者您已經完成了狩獵？

scripts.text:
^8B4513Clock Tower Dungeon^000000.
Which monster will you hunt or have you finished hunting?
scripts.translation:
^8B4513鐘樓地下城^000000
您要狩獵哪種魔物，或者您已經完成了狩獵？

scripts.text:
^8B4513Expansion Cities^000000
Which monster will you hunt or have you finished hunting?
scripts.translation:
^8B4513擴充套件城鎮^000000
您要狩獵哪種魔物，或者您已經完成了狩獵？

scripts.text:
[86-90 Mission Board]
Here is a list of random requests to hunt monsters in other regions of Midgard.
Which monster will you hunt or have you finished hunting?
scripts.translation:
[86-90級任務板]
這裡是米德加爾特其他地區隨機狩獵魔物任務的列表。
您要狩獵哪種魔物，或者您已經完成了狩獵？

scripts.text:
[86-90 Mission Board]
You need to wait 3 hours before you can take this mission again.
scripts.translation:
[86-90級任務板]
您需要等待3小時才能再次接受此任務。

scripts.text:
[86-90 Mission Board]
Have you finished hunting all 30 {0}{1} yet?
scripts.translation:
[86-90級任務板]
您已經完成了30只{0}{1}的狩獵了嗎？

scripts.text:
[86-90 Mission Board]
You have completed the hunting.
Please accept this reward as a compensation.
scripts.translation:
[86-90級任務板]
您已完成狩獵。
請收下這份獎勵作為補償。

scripts.text:
[86-90 Mission Board]
Hunt 30 {0} monsters there and post your success on this board.
scripts.translation:
[86-90級任務板]
去那裡狩獵30只{0}，並將成果記錄在此任務板上。

scripts.text:
[86-90 Mission Board]
When you have completed the mission, post it on this board and collect your reward.
scripts.translation:
[86-90級任務板]
完成狩獵後，請回到此任務板領取獎勵。
